svg.title: NFSU2 career save discovery grid
svg.desc: 54,966 bytes. Unlocated payload: 43,623 bytes (79.36%); Located, incomplete semantics: 6,104 bytes (11.11%); Deciphered fields: 5,239 bytes (9.53%). Read left to right, top to bottom; each cell is 64 bytes. Mixed cells show exact byte proportions.

g.text: How much of the career save have we deciphered?
Deciphered means field meaning + encoding known, not exhaustive in-game validation.
32 cells per row x 64 bytes = 2,048 bytes per row. Mixed colours are byte proportions.
